resources.string: Sign in with your GOG e-mail and password. Signing in through a linked account does not complete inside an app — if that is how you normally log in, set a GOG password first: gog.com → Sign in → Password reset.

Zomdroid never sees your password — you type it on GOG\'s own page. The access token is kept in memory only and is gone when the app closes; the sign-in cookies stay in this app\'s private storage so you are not asked every time, and signing out clears both.
